title: Distinguished Lecturer Series: Building Science - Adventures in Building Science
summary: A Berkeley Lab Distinguished Lecturer talk on building science, with an expert covering control layers, insulation and vapour barrier placement, and how buildings fail. The delivery is humorous.
why: HN commenters cite it as an authoritative, entertaining source on building science, such as insulation placement and why LEED point priorities miss the mark.

quote.text: Presentation on control layer (especially starting around 15m)
